title: Pre-Registered EFC Prediction: EG Statistic from SO × Euclid Cross-Correlation
description: This preregistration freezes an Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) prediction for the EG gravitational-slip statistic to be tested with the Simons Observatory (SO) CMB lensing cross-correlated with Euclid DR2 galaxy data. It specifies the predicted enhancement EG^EFC / EG^GR = 1.086 ± 0.012 at kc ≈ 0.05 h Mpc−1 and z ≈ 0.5, the dataset and estimator regime, and binding pass/fail (kill) criteria.

EG_statistic.description: Operational definition of the EG statistic used in SO × Euclid pipelines, combining CMB lensing–galaxy cross-power, galaxy auto-power, and RSD via beta = f/b.

EG_ratio_MG_to_GR.description: In the quasi-static sub-horizon limit, EG in modified gravity depends on the ratio of lensing enhancement to growth suppression relative to GR.

EFC_action.latex: S_{\rm EFC} = \int d^4x\, \sqrt{-g}\, \Big[ \tfrac{1}{2} M_{\rm Pl}^2 F(\phi) R - \tfrac{1}{2} K(\rho) g^{\mu\nu} \partial_\mu \phi \, \partial_\nu \phi - V(\phi) - \lambda \, \Box \phi - \Gamma(\rho) \Big]
EFC_action.description: Relativistic EFC action yielding self-consistent growth (mu), lensing (Sigma), and slip (eta) modifications from a single variational principle.

EFC_parameters.description: EFC benchmark values (frozen) producing growth suppression, lensing enhancement, and non-zero gravitational slip.

EFC_prediction_ratio.description: Sealed quantitative prediction for the SO × Euclid DR2 pipeline-weighted EG observable at the stated pivot scale and effective redshift.

key_results.main_finding: Sealed preregistered prediction that SO × Euclid DR2 will measure EG_obs / EG_GR = 1.086 ± 0.012 at kc ≈ 0.05 h Mpc−1, z ≈ 0.5, with a pass window [1.03, 1.14] and a fail (kill) condition at EG_obs / EG_GR = 1.00 ± 0.01 (>3σ).
datasets_used: Simons Observatory LAT CMB lensing reconstruction (κ)
Euclid DR2 photometric galaxy catalogue (z ∈ [0.3, 0.8], 5 tomographic bins)
ℓ-range: [50, 500]; pivot kc = 0.05 h Mpc−1; z_eff ≈ 0.5; survey-provided covariance and bias treatment

sealed_predictions.statement: Pipeline-level EG_obs / EG_GR = 1.086 ± 0.012 at kc ≈ 0.05 h Mpc−1 and z_eff ≈ 0.5 (SO LAT κ × Euclid DR2, ℓ ∈ [50, 500], tomography-convolved).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: SO × Euclid DR2 EG cross-correlation measurement with survey covariance and bias marginalisation as specified.

sealed_predictions.statement: Pass window: EG_obs / EG_GR ∈ [1.03, 1.14] at ≥ 1σ indicates consistency with the preregistered EFC prediction.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: SO × Euclid DR2 EG estimator result and reported uncertainty.

sealed_predictions.statement: Fail window (kill trigger): EG_obs / EG_GR = 1.00 ± 0.01 at > 3σ indicates GR-like slip and falsifies the EFC gravitational-slip sector.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: SO × Euclid DR2 EG measurement with total uncertainty yielding a >3σ consistency with unity.

kill_criteria: KC1 (KC-EG-FAIL / FA4): If SO × Euclid DR2 yields EG_obs / EG_GR = 1.00 ± 0.01 at > 3σ (ℓ ∈ [50, 500], kc ≈ 0.05 h Mpc−1, z_eff ≈ 0.5; tomography-convolved), the EFC gravitational-slip sector is formally abandoned and recorded in the Validation Ledger.
KC2 (FA4 slip bound): If |eta − 1| < 0.01 is established at > 3σ from the SO × Euclid EG measurement (within the declared regime and pipeline), the EFC perturbation sector is falsified.
